Student.title: Student
Student.description: A student in the class roster for a specific academic year.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated teacher who owns this student record.

roll.description: Roll or seat number of the student.

active.description: Whether the student is actively enrolled in attendance taking.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this record was created. Must be FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated. Must be FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

AttendanceRecord.title: AttendanceRecord
AttendanceRecord.description: A daily attendance log entry for a specific student.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated teacher who owns this record.

year.description: Academic year corresponding to this attendance entry.

date.description: Date of attendance in YYYY-MM-DD format.

status.description: Attendance status (P for Present, A for Absent).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this record was created. Must be FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated. Must be FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User preferences and active academic year configuration.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated teacher.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when settings were last modified.

/users/{userId}/students/{studentId}.description: Roster of students managed by the teacher.

/users/{userId}/attendance/{recordId}.description: Daily attendance logs taken by the teacher.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingsId}.description: Preferences and configuration for the teacher.
